description: V4 output-stage cell — covers Class-AB (dual-input, gate_n/gate_p) and Push-Pull (common-input) variants. Default geometry suits Class-AB common-source pair (MP/MN drains tied at out). Schema migrated from V3 class_ab_output_stage placement_guide (commit a07d68a) and adapted for V4 unified output-stage cell.

gate_n.description: NMOS gate (Class-AB low-side input). For Push-Pull single-input variant, tie gate_n=gate_p at caller layer.

gate_p.description: PMOS gate (Class-AB high-side input). For Push-Pull single-input variant, tie gate_n=gate_p at caller layer.
